success.title: Custom Database Prefix
success.details: Your WordPress database is using a custom table prefix ({prefix}), which enhances security.

error.title: Default Database Prefix
error.details: Your WordPress database is using the default 'wp_' table prefix, which is less secure.
steps: Use a database prefix change plugin

learn_more.description: The database prefix is used for all WordPress database tables. Using a custom prefix makes it harder for attackers to guess table names and execute automated SQL injection attacks.
benefits: Harder for attackers to guess table names
